title: Cell Adhesion Assay for HEK-293 and Cdh2-deficient HEK-293 Cells
author: Masahito Yamagata
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ppjdmkn
materials: Generate stably transfected cells which express the adhesive protein at the homogenous level. To generate stable cell lines, it is efficient to use pXL-BacII-XL-CAG-Zeo-tF2A-X system (Figure 1) as described in Yamagata et al. 2018 and Goodman et al., 2016. Culture them to almost confluency in 6 well plates or 60mm dish. The cells have to be healthy right before the experiment. If you need to label cells, use CellTracker(Invitrogen). CellTrackers are available in various colors. Add the stock solution to the culture medium, and incubate for 5-15 mins at 37C. Figure 1 a

Warm up 'Trypsin in PBS' at 37C. Adjust concentration of trypsin, and add EDTA or CaCl2 as needed. Typically, TE : 0.05-0.25%(w/v)Trypsin + 1mM EDTA in PBS (to remove Ca2+-dependent adhesion = cadherins) TC : 0.05-0.25%(w/v) Trypsin + 1mM CaCl2 in PBS (to protect Ca2+-dependent adhesion) For sensitive assay, use TPCK-treated trypsin (TPCK treatment removes chymotrypsin). But, tissue-culture grade trypsins also work for most cases (eg, Trypsin (0.25%) Thermo-Fisher 15050065). It is necessary to optimize the concentration of trypsin.

Stop the dissociation by adding 0.2 ml 1 mg/ml trypsin inhibitor (Sigma T6522) in PBS(-), 2 ml culture medium (without serum), and 10 microlitter of 1 mg/ml DNase (Sigma DN25). Mix with 1ml pipettman, and pipet in and out 20 times. No bubbles.

Count cells (Nt, total cell number) and aggregates (N, total particle number), and calculate Nt/N. N/Nt=1 means no aggregation. Typically, it is hard to analyze too large cell aggregates (eg, >100 cells). Thus, it is important to adjust reaction so that the cell mixtures do not contain too large aggregates. Example a A: 293TA (parental) after 1 hour B: 293NC (N-cadherin-deficient) after 1 hour. Cells were labeled with Cell Tracker Green CMFDA Dye (ThermoFisher). A: Nt=12, N=4 (Nt/N = 3) Aggregated B: Nt=12, N-12 (Nt/N = 1) No aggregation

steps.title: Precoat plates with BSA
steps.instruction: Coat each well of a 24‑well plate with 1 % (w/v) BSA in PBS and incubate for at least 2–3 h (overnight is typical). Non‑tissue‑culture plates are preferred, but tissue‑culture‑treated plates may also be used after coating.

steps.title: Detach cells with TE/TC
steps.instruction: Remove growth medium from the cultured HEK‑293 or Cdh2‑deficient cells, rinse briefly with calcium‑free PBS, then add 2 mL of trypsin‑EDTA (TE) or trypsin‑containing (TC) solution to each well. Incubate at 37 °C for 15–30 min (15 min works well for HEK‑293NC; longer incubation improves dissociation for HEK‑293T).

steps.title: Collect and centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension from each well into a 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge to pellet the cells (spin‑down).

steps.title: Resuspend cells in assay solution
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, then resuspend the cell pellet in chilled adhesion‑assay solution consisting of 0.5 % BSA in PBS + 20 mM HEPES, 1 µg/mL DNase (kept on ice). Triturate the suspension 10 times using a 1 mL pipette tip.

steps.title: Count cells on ice
steps.instruction: Keep the cell suspension on ice while counting the cells to determine the concentration.

steps.title: Add assay solution to wells
steps.instruction: Remove the BSA coating solution from the pre‑coated 24‑well plates (from Step 1) and add 0.8 mL of the chilled adhesion‑assay solution to each well.

steps.title: Add cells to wells
steps.instruction: Add cells to each well at a typical density of 1 × 10⁶ cells per well (1 × 10⁵ cells per well can be used for weaker adhesion). Mix gently by pipetting to ensure even distribution.

steps.title: Incubate on orbital shaker
steps.instruction: Place the plate on an orbital shaker and incubate either at room temperature or at 37 °C, depending on whether cadherin‑dependent adhesion is desired (37 °C enhances cadherin activity; room temperature suppresses background).

steps.title: Monitor aggregation and fix
steps.instruction: Observe cell aggregation periodically. For strong adhesion stop after 5–10 min; otherwise incubate 30 min to 1 h. To terminate the assay, add an equal volume (1 mL) of 4 % (w/v) paraformaldehyde in PBS to each well and mix. Store the fixed plate at 4 °C for up to several days.
